messages:
Nora H: FYI PR #1801 updated the Optimize quickstart to show prefetch config, but CI flagged two problems: the snippet uses `prefetch.policy: aggressive` (we standardized on `mode: automatic|manual`) and the markdown code fence had a language hint that breaks our renderer.

Diego R: Saw that. I also noticed the quant profile link in the same doc points to `/docs/qprofiles/old-anchor` which 404s on prod. We should switch to the stable alias `https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/latest`.

Mai S: For prefetch naming: let's use `prefetch.mode` everywhere and add a one-line compatibility note: "legacy boolean flags map to `mode: manual`." That avoids confusing customers.

Nora H: Agreed. Quick plan: 1) change `prefetch.policy` -> `prefetch.mode: automatic` in quickstart, 2) fix code fence to triple-backtick with `yaml` (our renderer prefers explicit language), 3) swap quant link to stable alias, 4) add tiny diagnostic curl for verifying prefetch metadata. Ticket DOCS-900.

Aaron P: I'll patch PR #1801 for the naming + renderer. For the diagnostic, suggest: 
```bash
# confirm prefetch applied
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-opt-6.7b","input":"prefix...","trace":true}' | jq '.meta.prefetch.mode'
```
Expect "automatic" for hosted default.

Diego R: Also add a short note about Dedicated: "Dedicated customers should prefer `manual` and coordinate with infra for prefetch memory limits." We have a few customer tickets about memory spikes when prefetch is aggressive.

docs-bot: PR #1801  check run started (docs-ci). 2 checks queued.

Mai S: Small UX ask: can we show both YAML quickstart and one-line SDK programmatic set? e.g., `client.config.prefetch.mode = "automatic"` so users see both. Keeps it friendly.

Aaron P: Added programmatic one-liners for Python + Go. Replaced `policy` with `mode`, fixed code fence, swapped quant link to stable alias, and added the diagnostic snippet. Updated PR body with DOCS-900 and a short changelog blurb. Pushing now.

docs-bot: PR #1801  check run succeeded (docs-ci). 4 checks passed.

Nora H: Excellent. Could someone file an infra redirect for the old anchor `/docs/qprofiles/old-anchor` -> `/qprofiles/latest`? Diego, can you file REDWOOD-1024?

Diego R: On it. Filed REDWOOD-1024 and added suggested redirect in the ticket.

Mai S: One more micro note: add a troubleshooting bullet about short-prefix truncation when switching to q8/q4 quant types (KV cache block-size change). Recommend running the above diagnostic and if truncation seen, prefer `max_tokens`-based batching.

Aaron P: Added the troubleshooting bullet and a tiny token-count pseudo-check example. Merged PR after approvals.

docs-bot: PR #1801 merged by Aaron P  site redeploy queued.

Nora H: Verified on staging: renderer fixed, prefetch naming normalized, diagnostic live, quant link resolves to alias. Closing DOCS-900. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
